name: Shade by the Yard
prompt: Stretch hops across sliding timber pergolas. Gardeners crank a bay of shade over occupied picnic tables while the sunny bay beside it fills with hop pickers and green wicker baskets.

name: The Cold Stone Tap
prompt: Wind a copper serving pipe past blocks of ice lowered into a stone cooling well. Show the brewer tapping a cask at one end and a tray of freshly filled glasses emerging at the other.

name: The Barrel Ferry
prompt: Roll little casks aboard a chain ferry crossing a planted rain channel. On opposite banks a brewer stamps the bungs and a waiter rolls the delivery straight under a long serving bench.

name: The Yeast Exchange
prompt: Build a glazed yeast nursery behind a garden bar. Brewers lift bubbling crocks into brass cradles while customers compare small pours beneath the different fruit trees that supplied the cultures.

name: A Choir of Steins
prompt: Seat communal tables around a little pottery kiln. A potter pulls newly fired stoneware mugs into the courtyard, where drinkers hang the cooled mugs by their handles on individual chestnut branches.
